notes.BUILTIN_ENGINE_IDS: Documented list used to validate and display the four built-in adapter ids.
notes.BUILTIN_THEME_REGISTRY: Documented lookup for built-in themes; consumers inspect or reuse entries.
notes.DEFAULT_THEME: Fallback theme object consumers can reuse when no theme is supplied.
notes.DEFAULT_THEME_NAME: Name of the fallback theme, needed to predict the emitted theme attribute.
notes.EngineManager: Documented low-level resolver for integrations that manage engines themselves.
notes.HIGHLIGHTER_CONTEXT: Injection key documented for advanced integrations that read or provide context.
notes.Light: Deprecated compatibility alias kept for react-syntax-highlighter migrations.
notes.LightAsync: Deprecated compatibility alias kept for react-syntax-highlighter migrations.
notes.PrismAsync: Deprecated compatibility alias kept for react-syntax-highlighter migrations.
notes.PrismLight: Deprecated compatibility alias kept for react-syntax-highlighter migrations.
notes.ResultCache: Public HighlightCacheLike implementation usable as a custom provider cache.
notes.SyntaxHighlighter: Primary component and the package's documented entry point.
notes.SyntaxHighlighterProvider: Documented provider for sharing engine, theme, and cache configuration.
notes.VueSyntaxHighlighter: Vue plugin install entry documented in the guide.
notes.buildCacheKey: Documented helper for cache-aware custom engine integrations.
notes.createHighlighter: Documented component-free entry point for build scripts and per-request SSR with an owned context and cache.
notes.createHighlighterContext: Documented low-level context factory whose signature is a compatibility contract.
notes.default: Plugin alias so app.use(VueSyntaxHighlighter) works without a named import.
notes.defineTheme: Documented factory for validated, frozen custom themes.
notes.isColorScheme: Documented guard for user-supplied color scheme values.
notes.isHighlightEngine: Documented contract guard for custom engine objects.
notes.stableStringify: Documented deterministic serializer paired with buildCacheKey.
notes.useSyntaxHighlighter: Composable documented for custom renderers and component-free highlighting.
